_comment: scripts/publication/check_publication.js verifies every entry against the
Git INDEX, not the local disk: a file that exists locally but was never
committed is a publication gap, which is exactly the defect this manifest
was added to catch (the reviewed commit referenced research/**,
asic/synthesis/**, six scripts and the memory inventory while none of
them were in the Git tree).
exact:  individual paths every supported command or current document
trees:  directories whose entire on-disk, non-ignored contents must be
tracked. This is the strict form: a new evidence file that is
left untracked fails the check instead of silently disappearing
excluded: pre-existing or generated material that is deliberately NOT
published. Listed so the exclusion is a recorded decision rather

excluded.why: Pre-existing ASIC phase-4 CTS repair databases (ODB/DEF) from another workstream. Binary design collateral, not referenced by any supported command in this repository.
Pre-existing reports from the physical-design workstream; not produced or consumed by this study's commands.
Pre-existing ASIC flow evidence from an earlier phase; unrelated to the study runs recorded under research/runs/.
Sky130 standard-cell liberty collateral. PDK/library material must not be redistributed from this repository.
Generated artifacts. Reproduced by the commands; never an input.
